provenance: Read-only probe design from original x86 PDB ABI and native decompile. Parent executes in isolated instrumented process; no original target or user save mutation.

execution.thread: Original Unity main thread via existing queued RPC on WorldMaster.Update. Do not call Unity-owned methods on Frida worker thread.
execution.baseline: Wait WorldMaster.state=42, game initialized. Existing persistence redirection and SaveMetaSaveToDisk suppression stay active.
execution.no_manual_dirty_write: Dirty probe must use natural MaybeSaveCurrent to clear flag; never directly assign anyChange/timestamps to simulate save.
execution.snapshot: Capture dirty and action fields immediately inside same main-thread task before returning to Update; also after state42. Wait by repeated queue tasks, not blocking main thread.
execution.wait: Wait state42 with bounded process observer timeout, recording state transitions rather than assume fixed frame delay.
execution.isolation: Clear/rebuild live history only in disposable probe process; synthetic history entries never Graph.ApplyAction/Undo.

WorldMaster.Load_string.native: bool __cdecl(WorldMaster* self, String* text, MethodInfo* method)

Maker.AddAction.native: Action* __cdecl(Action* return_storage, Maker* self, int2 pos_by_value, uint8 height, int8 in_type, int8 out_type, MethodInfo* method)
Maker.AddAction.managed: Action AddAction(int2 hexPos, byte height, VoxelType inType, VoxelType outType)
Maker.AddAction.invoke_note: Prefer existing il2cpp_runtime_invoke adapter: int2 is 8 bytes, enums byte, result boxed Action. Native direct call has hidden return storage and by-value int2, not a pointer in ordinary parameter position.

Graph.ApplyAction.native: void __cdecl(Graph* self, Action action_by_value, bool playEffect, MethodInfo* method)
Graph.ApplyAction.invoke_note: Action is 16-byte value; use existing runtime_invoke adapter instead of guessing NativeFunction aggregate ABI.

probes.name: world_load_height255
steps: Record baseline default save text outside native object, dirty fields, state.
Call WorldMaster.Load(string); record accepted and immediate state1. Do not GetSaveString until load completed because GetSaveString clears master.saveData, which is still Graph.IterateLoad input.
Allow original Update to reach42; capture transitions, Graph.maxHeight/boundsHeight/loadState.

Call GetSaveString, independently decode it with townscaper_codec.py. Compare occupied voxels including h255; Graph canonicalizes corner order and discards empty fixture corners, so do not require byte-identical input string or retain count0 corners.

expected.reason: Narrow bounds normalize to width b0; GetMaxExtents maxHeight256 accepts h<256. Input tallest voxel is255; edit gate separately uses h+1=256. End state requires full Graph/WFC/module pipeline, unlike codec-only.

probes.name: history_group_boundary
probes.setup: Use live Maker; ClearUndoQueue resets count/index/redoMax but preserves actionId. Remember initialId I. AddAction synthetic records only, no Graph edits, no SetDirty, no Undo. Position (0,0),h1,in0,out1 used as inert history data.
steps: For g1..998: BeginNewAction then AddAction once, except g1 twice. Record at g998.
Call TrimActionList at998 and record unchanged list.
BeginNewAction g999 plus one AddAction; record g999.
BeginNewAction g1000 plus one AddAction; record automatic oldest-group clipping.

ClearUndoQueue and recreate g1..999 with g1 twice, all others once; record and call TrimActionList; record explicit trimming. Also call CanRedo; expected false because index==list_size despite redoMax-count==1.

expected.note: J is actionId after second ClearUndoQueue. TrimActionList does not recompute actionRedoMax, change actionId, publish queue event, or begin new group. This exposes stale redoMax=999 while list/index represent998; report accurately rather than expecting max999 in standalone Trim.

probes.name: undo_redo_dirty_after_save
steps: Reload default baseline and wait42; ClearUndoQueue.
BeginNewAction; AddAction Empty18->color0 at(0,0,h3); Graph.ApplyAction same action true; EndAction sets dirty naturally. Wait42.
Call MaybeSaveCurrent with SaveMetaSaveToDisk suppressed (existing test hook), verify true and anyChange=false. No raw anyChange or timestamp writes. Snapshot dirty fields immediately.
Call Undo; snapshot fields immediately before returning to Update, then wait42 and GetSaveString. Verify restores baseline; call MaybeSaveCurrent and record bool.
Call Redo with no explicit SetDirty/EndAction; snapshot immediate dirty fields, wait42, GetSaveString. Verify restores edited string; call MaybeSaveCurrent and record bool.
Positive control EndAction: anyChange becomestrue and timestamps update; MaybeSaveCurrent resets false.

expected.scope: Demonstrates native Undo/Redo graph+history do not themselves mark dirty after natural snapshot submit. Persistence suppressed so no durability claim; full UI events may have outer callbacks and are a separate scope.
